title: Sunder Leveling into Pohx RF Swap
subtitle: Level with Sunder, then swap to Righteous Fire at Blood Aqueducts.

content.text: for leveling instead of the traditional caster approach. Play Sunder until Level 52-55, then use the free campaign respec and gold at Blood Aqueducts to hard-swap into Righteous Fire and follow Pohx's instructions. This approach allows you to level significantly quicker while still transitioning smoothly into the powerful RF setup once you reach maps.
